_comment: E01 T28 committed perf baselines (+ the E08 H2 perf-strip scenario).
Recorded by `cargo run --release -p lbx-perf` on the M0 exit-drill
machine (see below); the nightly workflow compares every run against
entry is a REGRESSION (files the tracked issue, non-blocking per spec
§8); exceeding 2x a `scenarios` value is an advisory `watch` marker
only, because these numbers are machine-relative and CI runners
differ. Re-bless by re-running lbx-perf on comparable hardware and
pasting the numbers here. perf-strip (E08 H2, replaces the retired
grid-scroll capture) runs windowed via `lbx-perf --scenario perf-strip`
< 16 ms with the develop rail open, nav-swap p95 < 50 ms. The
`reference` block records dev-machine numbers the comparator ignores.
machine: Apple M5 Max, macOS aarch64, Metal (E01 T29 drill machine)

open-1k._comment: E04 T11 — recorded on a dev sandbox (not the pinned E01 drill machine above); re-bless on the drill machine when convenient.

develop-slider._comment: E10 A14 — recorded 2026-07-10 in `cargo run --release -p lbx-perf` (a debug build shows ~600ms p95 — unoptimized per-pixel exposure-kernel cost, not representative; the shipped app is always release). No `budgets` entry: the <100ms fit-view gate is DEFERRED to the nightly reference-runner per prior-epic precedent (E05 F1/E08 H2) — this local number is comfortably under it already (Apple M5 Max, Metal) but is not the gate of record.

perf-strip._comment: E08 H2 — recorded 2026-07-10 on the E01 drill machine (Apple M5 Max, Metal, 120 Hz display: p50/p95 sit on the 8.3 ms vsync cadence). open_to_first_pixels is measured on a 300-file open (a conservative upper bound on the single-file §7 drop budget).

grid-scroll.note: RETIRED (E08 Phase A/H2): the grid + --perf-scroll no longer exist; kept as the historical pre-rescope record. The successor capture is the perf-strip scenario above.
